## Acceptance criteria

<!-- Use observable, testable end states. Address every category; mark a category not applicable only with a concrete reason. -->

- [ ] Security, privacy, ownership, secrets, and data-integrity requirements are satisfied.
- [ ] User-facing, setup, architecture, or planning documentation is updated where the change makes it necessary.
- [ ] The change stays within this issue and does not include sibling or non-goal work.
